## Participants and scope

This teaching model shows one successful exchange. Client is the caller; Service handles the request. A participant is a sender or receiver of messages. The dashed vertical line below each participant traces its role through the exchange.

slides.title: One successful exchange
slides.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant Service
  Client->>Service: Request
  Service-->>Client: Response
slides.explanationMarkdown: Read the messages from top to bottom. First, Client sends Request to Service. After handling it, Service sends Response back to Client. Here the dashed arrow marks the reply; its arrowhead points to Client, the receiver.

blocks.markdown:
## Conclusion

The request starts the exchange; the response returns to the original caller. This diagram does not show retries, failure, how long the work takes, or what Client does after the response.
